news.title: Trump orders government, Fed to review crypto firms' access to payment rails
news.summary: Donald Trump's executive order asks the Fed to review how depository institutions may be granted access to payment services, an area the crypto industry is deeply involved with.

news.title: Bitcoin is falling, bond yields are rising. Yet BTC’s implied volatility, an uncertainty gauge, remains low.
news.summary: BTC's implied volatility remains low despite the recent price selloff. Options specialist prefers a long straddle strategy in this scenario.

news.title: Bitcoin, ether, XRP rebound as Senate curbs Trump's Iran war powers
news.summary: Bitcoin climbed to about $77,200, while XRP, ether and solana also gained as Treasury yields and oil fell.

news.title: Bitfinex traders double down on bitcoin during five-day slide as longs hit 2.5-year high
news.summary: Margin longs on Bitfinex have climbed to a two-and-a-half year high as bitcoin struggles below key technical resistance near $78,000.

news.title: Bitcoin holds near $77,400 as derivatives signal caution
news.summary: Crypto markets flashed green on Wednesday, but falling futures open interest and mixed altcoin performances suggest traders are reducing risk rather than chasing the rebound.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
